```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(googlesheets4)
library(powerjoin)
library(janitor)
library(qs)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(here)
library(fgsea)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica")
)
```

## Loading data

```{r}
patho_scores_raw <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1eATs2B_xOC9rx1VN9dDIbHpNp9iPk6Q7hrkl8zfP9Dk/edit?gid=0#gid=0"
) %>%
  drop_na(`LSP ID`) %>%
  rename(
    Albumin = `Albumin (tubule)`
  )

orion_quants_and_clinical_raw <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a1nLyFQNTJYoVWLX9JS2wIItvTqnxLVJ30NXdnLd7AE/edit?gid=382231029#gid=382231029",
  sheet = 1
)

diagnosis_raw <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GLE_FFPOROKKij08Pxl5ipKuSp3pdQAIqOrJ_ad8MlQ/edit?gid=1315829101#gid=1315829101",
  sheet = "Diagnosis_Readable"
)

clinical_scores_raw <- orion_quants_and_clinical_raw %>%
  select(
    `LSP ID` = slideName,
    ends_with("_score")
  ) %>%
  rename_with(\(x) str_remove(x, fixed("_score"))) %>%
  rename(
    `Lambda LC` = Lambda,
    `Kappa LC` = Kappa
  )

orion_quants_raw <- orion_quants_and_clinical_raw %>%
  transmute(
    `LSP ID` = slideName,
    caseID = as.character(caseID),
    across(starts_with("mean_"))
  ) %>%
  rename_with(\(x) str_remove(x, fixed("mean_"))) %>%
  rename(
    `Lambda LC` = Lambda,
    `Kappa LC` = Kappa
  )
```

```{r dt-setup}
dt_options <- list(
  dom = "Bfrtip",
  buttons = "copy"
)

dt_format_signif <- function(dt) {
  formatSignif(
    dt,
    keep(dt$x$data, is.numeric) %>% names(),
    digits = 2
  )
}

dt_default_table <- function(df) {
  datatable(
    df,
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = dt_options
  ) %>%
    dt_format_signif()
}
```


## Data processing

```{r}
diagnosis <- diagnosis_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -`Case ID`,
    names_to = "diagnosis",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(value == 1) %>%
  select(-value)

diagnosis_lsp_id <- diagnosis %>%
  filter(
    `Case ID` != "E23-1562"
  ) %>%
  power_inner_join(
    orion_quants_raw %>%
      select(`LSP ID`, caseID),
    by = c("Case ID" = "caseID"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
      unmatched_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )
```

## Compute ratios

```{r}
kl_ratios <- orion_quants_raw %>%
  filter(
    caseID != "E23-1562"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    `LSP ID`, caseID,
    across(ends_with("LC")),
    `KL ratio` = log2(`Kappa LC`) - log2(`Lambda LC`)
  )
```

## KL ratio patient set enrichment test

```{r}
kl_vector <- with(
  kl_ratios,
  set_names(`KL ratio`, `LSP ID`)
)

patient_sets <- with(
  diagnosis_lsp_id,
  split(`LSP ID`, diagnosis)
)

fgsea_res <- fgseaMultilevel(
  patient_sets,
  kl_vector
  # scoreType = "pos"
)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
dt_default_table(select(fgsea_res, -leadingEdge))
```


```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
p <- plotGseaTable(
  patient_sets,
  kl_vector,
  fgsea_res
)
p
```
